red.definition: The colour of the setting sun, blood, and strawberries; the colour which is evoked by the longest visible wavelengths (between about 625–740 nm), and a primary additive colour.

reduced.definition: Form of reduce (participle past): To bring down the size, quantity, quality, value or intensity of something; to diminish, to lower.

referring.definition: Form of refer (gerund participle present): To direct the attention of (someone toward something).

register.definition: To enter in a register; to enlist.

registers.definition: Form of register (indicative present singular third-person): To enter in a register; to enlist.

relationship.definition: Connection or association; the condition of being related.

remain.definition: To stay after others or other parts have been removed or otherwise disappeared.

requires.definition: Form of require (indicative present singular third-person): To demand, to insist upon (having); to call for authoritatively.

resolution.definition: A firm decision or an official decision.

respect.definition: An attitude of consideration or high regard; a feeling of admiration or esteem.

result.definition: That which results; the conclusion or end to which any course or condition of things leads, or which is obtained by any process or operation; consequence or effect.

resultant.definition: Anything that results from something else; an outcome.

results.definition: Form of result (plural): That which results; the conclusion or end to which any course or condition of things leads, or which is obtained by any process or operation; consequence or effect.

reversals.definition: Form of reversal (plural): The state of being reversed.

right.definition: Designating the side of the body which is positioned to the east if one is facing north, the side on which the heart is not located in most humans. This arrow points to the reader's right: →.

rom.definition: A member of the Romani people.

said.definition: Form of say (participle past): To pronounce.

scale.definition: A ladder; a series of steps; a means of ascending.

scanned.definition: Form of scan (participle past): To examine sequentially, carefully, or critically; to scrutinize; to behold closely.

second.definition: Something that is number two in a series.

see.definition: To perceive or detect someone or something with the eyes, or as if by sight.

selected.definition: Form of select (participle past): To choose one or more elements of a set, especially a set of options.

selecting.definition: Form of select (gerund participle present): To choose one or more elements of a set, especially a set of options.

selection.definition: The process or act of selecting.

selectively.definition: In a selective manner, only affecting or applying to some selected cases.

separate.definition: To divide (a thing) into separate parts.

sequence.definition: A set of things next to each other in a set order; a series.

sequencing.definition: Form of sequence (gerund participle present): To arrange (something) in an order.

sequency.definition: Half the number of zero crossings in the time base of a Walsh function.

serially.definition: In series, one after the other, as opposed to in parallel.

seven.definition: The digit/figure 7 or an occurrence thereof.

shall.definition: Used before a verb to indicate the simple future tense in the first person singular or plural.

sharp.definition: Terminating in a point or edge, especially one that can cut or pierce easily; not dull, obtuse, or rounded.

sharply.definition: In a sharp manner, in various senses.

shift.definition: To move from one place to another; to redistribute.

shifted.definition: Form of shift (participle past): To move from one place to another; to redistribute.

shown.definition: Form of show (participle past): To display or exhibit; to have somebody see (something); to direct attention to something.

signal.definition: A sequence of states representing an encoded message in a communication channel.

signals.definition: Form of signal (plural): A sequence of states representing an encoded message in a communication channel.

similar.definition: Having traits or characteristics in common; alike, allied, comparable.

single.definition: Not accompanied by anything else; one in number.

solution.definition: A homogeneous mixture, which may be liquid, gas or solid, formed by dissolving one or more substances.

source.definition: The person, place, or thing from which something (information, goods, etc.) comes or is acquired.

standard.definition: A principle or example or measure used for comparison.

state.definition: A condition; a set of circumstances applying at any given time.

states.definition: Form of state (plural): A condition; a set of circumstances applying at any given time.

storage.definition: The act of storing goods; the state of being stored.

stored.definition: Form of store (participle past): To keep (something) while not in use, generally in a place meant for that purpose.

subcarrier.definition: A separate signal carried on a main radio transmission, often carrying additional information such as voice or data.

submultiple.definition: A quantity that gives another quantity when multiplied by an integer.

substantially.definition: In a strong or substantial manner; considerably.

such.definition: Something being indicated that is similar to something else.

suitable.definition: Having sufficient or the required properties for a certain purpose or task; appropriate to a certain occasion.

synchronization.definition: The state or property of being synchronized.

synchronized.definition: Form of synchronize (participle past): To cause two or more events or actions to happen at exactly the same time or same rate, or in a time-coordinated way.

synchronizing.definition: Form of synchronize (gerund participle present): To cause two or more events or actions to happen at exactly the same time or same rate, or in a time-coordinated way.

taken.definition: Form of take (participle past): To get into one's hands, possession, or control, with or without force.

techniques.definition: Form of technique (plural): The practical aspects of a given art, occupation etc.; formal requirements.

television.definition: An electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound.

that.definition: To a given extent or degree.

the.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.

their.definition: Form of there (misspelling): In or at a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) that is perceived to be away from, or at a relative distance from, the speaker (compare here).

there.definition: In or at a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) that is perceived to be away from, or at a relative distance from, the speaker (compare here).

thereby.definition: By it; by that; by that means, or as a consequence of that.

third.definition: The person or thing in the third position.

this.definition: To the degree or extent indicated.

through.definition: From one side of something to the other.

time.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.

timing.definition: Form of time (gerund participle present): To measure or record the time, duration, or rate of something.

to.definition: Toward a closed, touching, or engaging position.

toggles.definition: Form of toggle (plural): A wooden or metal pin, short rod, crosspiece or similar, fixed transversely in the eye of a rope or chain to be secured to any other loop, ring, or bight, e.g. a sea painter to a lifeboat.

toggling.definition: Form of toggle (gerund participle present): To alternate between two positions using a single switch or lever.

total.definition: To add up; to calculate the sum of.

toward.definition: Yielding, pliant; docile; ready or apt to learn; not froward.

transparent.definition: See-through, clear; having the property that light passes through it almost undisturbed, such that one can see through it clearly.

tri-state.definition: Form of tristate (alternative): Having, or pertaining to, three distinct states.

tube.definition: Anything that is hollow and cylindrical in shape.

tubes.definition: Form of tube (plural): Anything that is hollow and cylindrical in shape.

typically.definition: In a typical or common manner.

understood.definition: Form of understand (participle past): To know the meaning of; to parse or have parsed correctly; to comprehend.

unique.definition: Being the only one of its kind; unequaled, unparalleled or unmatched.

unit.definition: Oneness, singularity, seen as a component of a whole number; a magnitude of one.

upper.definition: At a higher physical position, level, rank or order.

used.definition: Form of use (participle past): To utilize or employ.

uses.definition: Form of use (plural): The act of using.

using.definition: Form of use (gerund participle present): To utilize or employ.

vertical.definition: Standing, pointing, or moving straight up or down; parallel to the local direction of gravity; along the direction of a plumb line; perpendicular to something horizontal.

vertically.definition: In a vertical direction or position.

very.definition: To a great extent or degree.

via.definition: A main road or highway, especially in ancient Rome. (Mainly used in set phrases, below.)

video.definition: Transient visual content or media, processed with technology, especially electronic.

violet.definition: A plant or flower of the genus Viola, especially the fragrant Viola odorata; (inexact) similar-looking plants and flowers.

volume.definition: A three-dimensional measure of space that comprises a length, a width and a height. It is measured in units of cubic centimeters in metric, cubic inches or cubic feet in English measurement.

waveforms.definition: Form of waveform (plural): The shape of a wave function represented by a graph showing some dependent variable as function of an independent variable.

well-defined.definition: Having a clean and distinct outline.

well-known.definition: Familiar, famous, renowned, noted or widely known.

when.definition: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

whereby.definition: By what, in which direction; how.

while.definition: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.

white.definition: Form of white (Canada UK US not-comparable sometimes): Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

y.definition: Form of year (abbreviation): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

zero.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.
